title.narrative: Maintaining Access to and Quality of Essential M/XDR-TB Services in Azerbaijan - Azerbaijan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Azerbaijan, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan (MOH Azerbaijan)This program has the following goals: To reduce the socio-economic burden of TB in Azerbaijan through significant decline in TB (including drug-resistant TB) incidence, prevalence, and mortality. The objectives of this program are: Ensure integrated, patient-centred care and prevention. Pursue bold policies and supportive systems. Enable and promote research and innovation

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for AZE-T-MOHP02
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
TB I-Other 1: RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among previously treated TB patients
Outcome indicators targets and results for AZE-T-MOHP02
Treatment success rate of all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, new and relapse
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for AZE-T-MOHP02
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Number of cases of XDR TB enrolled on treatment
Percentage of confirmed MDR-TB cases tested for susceptibility to any fluoroquinolone and any second-line injectable drug
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
